actor_replay.qualification: Exact shared pre-action tensors; offline BC replay does not predict a counterfactual physical outcome.

selected_correction.name: Phase-selective behavioral anchor during PPO
selected_correction.proposal: Use the original demonstrated categorical actions as an auxiliary actor BC loss during holding/recovery; no global reward or speed-ramp change.
selected_correction.evidence: Deterministic PPO loses demonstrated BRAKE/RECOVER decisions on identical pre-action tensors; compare BC replay before choosing coefficient.
selected_correction.scope: One future new-contract pilot only after a bounded gradient-balance check; not implemented in the preserved actor and not started.
selected_correction.expected_effect: Preserve complete disturbance sequences; reduction of physical slip is a hypothesis, not an established result.

limitations: Phase exposures and physical positions differ; phase comparisons are descriptive, not causal intervention results.
Startup/approach slip differs despite full-scale commands. It is not justified to attribute this difference to PPO braking or recovery.
Ground-truth slip is retained for scoring; no scoring exclusions or metric changes.
